messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — thinking we should rework next week's newsletter cadence and split the webinar invite into three nurture cohorts. current plan feels noisy. cc @Ana @Priya
Ana: Agree. Can we A/B subject lines and route high-intent leads differently? what cohorts are you thinking?
Sam: Cohorts: 1) Recent signups (0-7d), 2) Engaged users (opened 2+ in 30d), 3) Dormant (30-90d). Proposed split: 40/40/20. Quick numbers: Recent 4,200; Engaged 3,500; Dormant 1,800.
Priya: Love it. For routing — Recent + Engaged should tag as `webinar_opt_in` and flow to SDR queue; Dormant -> long nurture only. That should cut SDR noise.
Jordyn: Subject line ideas — dropping three options for A/B:
```
A) Redwood Inference: Save seats for our scaling inference webinar — Mar 31
B) How teams cut inference cost 3x — join our webinar
C) Webinar: Make LLM inference predictable (limited seats)
```
Ana: I'd test A vs B for Recent/Engaged, push C to Dormant. Also standardize a 3-email cadence: invite (T-6), reminder (T-3), last-chance (T-1).
Sam: Perfect. Ops note: send windows should be local 9am. @Mike can you handle scheduling + suppression? include dynamic insert {{company}} for personalization.
Mike: Yep. I'll set timezone sends, upload suppression lists (do-not-contact + converted leads), and add the dynamic tags. Need final creative and subject by EOD Tue to hit sends.
Priya: Landing page needs `lead_route=webinar_opt_in` param so inbound routing tags correctly. I'll add UTMs: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=webinar_mar31`.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Scaling Inference Webinar — Mar 31" — 11:00 PDT -> 12:00 PDT. RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/scale-inference
Sam: One more — analytics: we need to track `invite_open`, `rsvp_click`, `attended` and map to cohort + SDR handoff. Jordyn can you drop the tracking spec and a simple mapping table?
Jordyn: On it — will post the tracking sheet by tomorrow morning. Quick ask: keep subject <=60 chars for mobile; preview text should be 90-110 chars and include a clear CTA.
Ana: Also flag test cells: a small holdback (5%) for control and one small holdback for personalization off. We want to measure lift.
Priya: Noted — I'll create segments in the ESP with holdback flags. Will also make sure Dormant cohort only gets option C and a softer CTA.
Mike: Scheduling note — blackout: don't send to active webinar registrants or recent demo converts in last 14 days. I'll add that suppression rule.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Ping here when A/B is live and the creative is uploaded. :thumbsup:
Ana: Will do.
Sam: Thanks — moving to action items in the thread.
